preimage:
name: Hepta MEM candidate and replay controls

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/hepta-mem-python.yml
      - scripts/ndu_real_runtime/**
      - scripts/ndu_real_materials/**
      - scripts/memory_cell_mem1/**
      - scripts/memory_cell_mem3/**
      - experiments/multimodal_output_portfolio/joint_hepta_20261029/hepta_core.py
      - scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py
      - codex-rs/hepta-memory/**
      - codex-rs/hepta-agentd/**
      - codex-rs/hepta-agent-protocol/**
      - codex-rs/rust-toolchain.toml
      - .github/actions/setup-ci/**
      - scripts/format.py
      - scripts/run-nextest.py
      - justfile
  push:
    branches:
      - research/mem-integrated-20261109-a6b21bc7
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: hepta-mem-python-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
  TESTED_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
  BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}
  HEPTA_CI_LANE: source-head
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
  PYTHONPATH: scripts:.
  OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
  MKL_NUM_THREADS: "1"
  OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS: "1"

jobs:
  episodic-integrity:
    name: Source-memory receipts and post-update revocation
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 8
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact source commit
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.SOURCE_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Bind source-head identity before integrity tests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem7-records"
          git rev-parse HEAD HEAD^{tree} > "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem7-records/source-before.txt"
          git status --porcelain > "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem7-records/worktree-before.txt"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SOURCE_SHA"
          test ! -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem7-records/worktree-before.txt"
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a309ff8b426b58ec0e2a45f0f869d46889d02405
        with:
          python-version: "3.12.16"
      - name: Check standard-library integrity and fresh readers
        run: |
          python scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 180 --minimum-tests 24 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem7-records/tests.json" \
            -- python -B -m unittest -v ndu_real_runtime.test_episodic_memory \
            ndu_real_runtime.test_episodic_retrieval \
            ndu_real_runtime.test_episodic_qualification \
            ndu_real_runtime.test_revocation_qualification
      - name: Record the isolated revocation campaign
        run: |
          python -B -m ndu_real_runtime.run_revocation_qualification \
            --source-commit "$SOURCE_SHA" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem7-records/campaign"
      - name: Bind source-head identity after integrity tests
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem7-records"
          git rev-parse HEAD HEAD^{tree} > "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem7-records/source-after.txt"
          git status --porcelain > "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem7-records/worktree-after.txt"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SOURCE_SHA"
          test ! -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem7-records/worktree-after.txt"
      - name: Retain integrity evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: mem7-integrity-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/mem7-records
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
  native-owner:
    name: Staged native episodic owner contracts
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 120
    env:
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "2"
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
      CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG: "0"
      CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: "0"
      SOURCE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref || github.ref }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.SOURCE_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 2
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Bind exact comparison and staged source presence
        id: stage
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          records="$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records"
          mkdir -p "$records"
          exec > >(tee "$records/preflight.log") 2>&1
          if [[ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" == workflow_dispatch ]]; then
            BASE_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD^)"
            echo "BASE_SHA=$BASE_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          fi
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_history.py --commit "$BASE_SHA" --commit "$SOURCE_SHA"
          git rev-parse HEAD HEAD^{tree} > "$records/source-before.txt"
          git status --porcelain > "$records/worktree-before.txt"
          printf '%s\n' "$SOURCE_REF" "$SOURCE_SHA" "$BASE_SHA" > "$records/event-identity.txt"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SOURCE_SHA"
          test ! -s "$records/worktree-before.txt"
          git diff --binary "$BASE_SHA" "$SOURCE_SHA" > "$records/source.patch"
          git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMRT -z "$BASE_SHA" "$SOURCE_SHA" > "$records/source-paths.zlist"
          tar --null -T "$records/source-paths.zlist" -czf "$records/changed-source-before.tar.gz"
          memory=false; control=false; protocol=false; drain=false
          [[ ! -f codex-rs/hepta-memory/src/episodic_source.rs ]] || memory=true
          [[ ! -f codex-rs/hepta-agentd/src/production_episodic_control_tests.rs ]] || control=true
          [[ ! -f codex-rs/hepta-agent-protocol/src/episodic.rs ]] || protocol=true
          [[ ! -f codex-rs/hepta-agentd/src/production_episodic_drain_tests.rs ]] || drain=true
          printf 'memory=%s\ncontrol=%s\nprotocol=%s\ndrain=%s\n' "$memory" "$control" "$protocol" "$drain" | tee "$records/stages.txt" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          printf 'Absent stages have no native test result; infrastructure success is not owner qualification.\n' >> "$records/stages.txt"
          cat "$records/stages.txt" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          [[ "$control" == false || ( "$memory" == true && "$protocol" == true ) ]]
          [[ "$drain" == false || "$control" == true ]]
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-ci
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@d86e0fa8f147d6539442c26a61ebba8becc19489
        with:
          toolchain: "1.96.0"
          components: rustfmt, clippy
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@08807647e7069bb48b6ef5acd8ec9567f424441b
        with:
          version: "0.11.3"
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@44c6d64aa62cd779e873306675c7a58e86d6d532
        with:
          tool: nextest@0.9.103
      - name: Retain native tool versions
        shell: bash
        working-directory: codex-rs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          { rustup show active-toolchain; rustc --version --verbose; cargo --version; just --version; cargo nextest --version; uv --version; } 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records/tools.log"
      - name: Format exact PR changes and reject any source rewrite
        run: |
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 900 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records/format.json" \
            -- just fmt --base "$BASE_SHA"
      - name: Install existing native build prerequisites
        if: steps.stage.outputs.memory == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          { sudo apt-get update; sudo apt-get install -y build-essential clang cmake protobuf-compiler libssl-dev libcap-dev pkg-config bubblewrap; } 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records/native-prerequisites.log"
      - name: Resolve repository-verified V8 inputs for the control stage
        if: steps.stage.outputs.control == 'true'
        run: |
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 900 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records/v8-inputs.json" \
            -- python3 scripts/hepta_ci_v8.py
      - name: Test staged memory owner contracts on unchanged source
        if: steps.stage.outputs.memory == 'true'
        run: |
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 6600 --minimum-tests 1 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records/memory-tests.json" \
            -- just test --locked -p codex-hepta-memory --lib episodic
      - name: Build and bind the exact Codex executable for real App Server drain
        if: steps.stage.outputs.drain == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 6600 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records/codex-build.json" \
            -- cargo build --locked --manifest-path codex-rs/Cargo.toml -p codex-cli --bin codex
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          import stat
          import subprocess

          metadata = json.loads(subprocess.check_output([
              "cargo", "metadata", "--locked", "--no-deps", "--format-version", "1",
              "--manifest-path", "codex-rs/Cargo.toml",
          ]))
          binary = Path(metadata["target_directory"]) / "debug" / "codex"
          before = binary.lstat()
          if not stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) or not os.access(binary, os.X_OK):
              raise SystemExit("exact-source Codex binary is not an executable regular file")
          digest = hashlib.sha256()
          with binary.open("rb") as handle:
              for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
                  digest.update(chunk)
          after = binary.lstat()
          if (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) != (
              after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns
          ):
              raise SystemExit("Codex binary changed while recording its identity")
          record = {
              "source_sha": os.environ["SOURCE_SHA"],
              "source_tree": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}"], text=True).strip(),
              "path": str(binary),
              "bytes": after.st_size,
              "sha256": digest.hexdigest(),
          }
          records = Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"]) / "mem-native-records"
          (records / "codex-binary.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
          with Path(os.environ["GITHUB_ENV"]).open("a") as handle:
              handle.write(f"CARGO_BIN_EXE_codex={binary}\n")
          PY
      - name: Test staged Agentd control contracts on unchanged source
        if: steps.stage.outputs.control == 'true'
        run: |
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 6600 --minimum-tests 1 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records/agentd-tests.json" \
            -- just test --locked -p codex-hepta-agentd --lib episodic --no-capture --retries 0
      - name: Test the qualification feature preserves explicit memory isolation
        if: steps.stage.outputs.control == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          records="$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records"
          junit="$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/nextest/local/junit.xml"
          test -f "$junit"
          test ! -L "$junit"
          test ! -e "$records/agentd-nextest.junit.xml"
          mv "$junit" "$records/agentd-nextest.junit.xml"
          profile_exit=0
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 1200 --minimum-tests 1 \
            --output "$records/agentd-qualification-profile-tests.json" \
            -- just test --locked -p codex-hepta-agentd --features qualification-cognitive-write \
            --lib app_runtime::tests::episodic_embedding_keeps_the_store_but_removes_implicit_memory_paths \
            --no-capture --retries 0 || profile_exit=$?
          if [[ -f "$junit" && ! -L "$junit" ]]; then
            cp "$junit" "$records/agentd-qualification-profile.junit.xml"
          fi
          if [[ "$profile_exit" -ne 0 ]]; then
            exit "$profile_exit"
          fi
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from datetime import datetime
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          import uuid
          import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

          records = Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"]) / "mem-native-records"
          previous = ET.parse(records / "agentd-nextest.junit.xml").getroot()
          current = ET.parse(records / "agentd-qualification-profile.junit.xml").getroot()
          receipt = json.loads((records / "agentd-qualification-profile-tests.json").read_text())
          cases = current.findall(".//testcase")
          expected = "app_runtime::tests::episodic_embedding_keeps_the_store_but_removes_implicit_memory_paths"
          if (len(cases) != 1 or cases[0].get("name") != expected
                  or current.get("tests") != "1" or current.get("failures") != "0"
                  or current.get("errors") != "0"
                  or any(cases[0].find(tag) is not None for tag in ("failure", "error", "skipped"))
                  or receipt["status"] != "passed" or receipt["observed_passed_tests"] != 1
                  or receipt["observed_failed_tests"] != 0):
              raise SystemExit("qualification profile did not pass exactly its original case")
          run_uuid = str(uuid.UUID(current.attrib["uuid"]))
          if run_uuid == previous.get("uuid"):
              raise SystemExit("qualification profile reused a previous nextest report")
          case_time = datetime.fromisoformat(cases[0].attrib["timestamp"])
          if not (datetime.fromisoformat(receipt["started_at"]) <= case_time
                  <= datetime.fromisoformat(receipt["finished_at"])):
              raise SystemExit("qualification profile case is outside its execution interval")
          PY
      - name: Test protocol package after the control stage is present
        if: steps.stage.outputs.control == 'true'
        run: |
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 1800 --minimum-tests 1 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records/protocol-tests.json" \
            -- just test --locked -p codex-hepta-agent-protocol
      - name: Run scoped fixes after tests and reject any source rewrite
        if: steps.stage.outputs.memory == 'true'
        env:
          CONTROL_PRESENT: ${{ steps.stage.outputs.control }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          packages=(codex-hepta-memory)
          if [[ "$CONTROL_PRESENT" == true ]]; then
            packages+=(codex-hepta-agentd codex-hepta-agent-protocol)
          fi
          for package in "${packages[@]}"; do
            python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 6600 \
              --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records/fix-$package.json" \
              -- just fix --locked -p "$package"
          done
      - name: Retain final source, full rewrite patch and changed files
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          records="$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records"
          mkdir -p "$records"
          exec > >(tee "$records/final-source.log") 2>&1
          git rev-parse HEAD HEAD^{tree} > "$records/source-after.txt"
          git status --porcelain > "$records/worktree-after.txt"
          git diff --binary HEAD > "$records/source-rewrites.patch"
          git diff --cached --binary > "$records/index-rewrites.patch"
          git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMRT -z HEAD > "$records/rewrite-paths.zlist"
          git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z >> "$records/rewrite-paths.zlist"
          tar --null -T "$records/rewrite-paths.zlist" -czf "$records/changed-source-after.tar.gz"
          if [[ -f "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-$RUNNER_TEMP/absent-target}/nextest/local/junit.xml" ]]; then
            cp "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/nextest/local/junit.xml" "$records/last-nextest.junit.xml"
          fi
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path

          records = Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"]) / "mem-native-records"
          identity = records / "codex-binary.json"
          if identity.exists():
              before = json.loads(identity.read_text())
              binary = Path(before["path"])
              digest = hashlib.sha256()
              with binary.open("rb") as handle:
                  for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
                      digest.update(chunk)
              after = dict(before, bytes=binary.stat().st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())
              (records / "codex-binary-after.json").write_text(json.dumps(after, indent=2) + "\n")
              if before != after or binary.is_symlink():
                  raise SystemExit("the bound Codex executable changed during native validation")
          PY
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SOURCE_SHA"
          cmp "$records/source-before.txt" "$records/source-after.txt"
          test ! -s "$records/worktree-after.txt"
      - name: Retain native logs and exact-source evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: mem-native-${{ env.SOURCE_SHA }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/mem-native-records
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
  python:
    name: Frozen candidate and coverage contracts
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact source commit
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.SOURCE_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a309ff8b426b58ec0e2a45f0f869d46889d02405
        with:
          python-version: "3.12.16"
      - name: Retain source and install real CPU actor dependencies
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          records="$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records"
          mkdir -p "$records"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SOURCE_SHA"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
          git rev-parse HEAD HEAD^{tree} > "$records/source-identity.txt"
          python --version > "$records/python-version.txt"
          python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check \
            --report "$records/torch-install.json" \
            --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu 'torch==2.9.1+cpu'
          python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check \
            --report "$records/numeric-install.json" 'numpy==1.26.4' 'Pillow==12.0.0'
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends tesseract-ocr tesseract-ocr-eng
          dpkg-query -W 'tesseract*' > "$records/ocr-packages.txt"
          python -m pip check > "$records/dependency-check.txt"
          python -m pip freeze --all > "$records/installed-versions.txt"
      - name: Check real actor and independent candidate evidence
        run: |
          python scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 300 --minimum-tests 17 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records/candidate-tests.json" \
            -- python -B -m unittest -v ndu_real_runtime.test_candidate_memory \
            ndu_real_runtime.test_candidate_runtime ndu_real_runtime.test_candidate_retention_report
      - name: Check identical-support selectors and bound action receipts
        run: |
          python scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 120 --minimum-tests 10 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records/selector-tests.json" \
            -- python -B -m unittest -v ndu_real_runtime.test_candidate_selector \
            ndu_real_runtime.test_selector_runtime
      - name: Check replay matching and incomplete-run accounting
        run: |
          python scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 120 --minimum-tests 6 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records/replay-tests.json" \
            -- python -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/memory_cell_mem1 \
            -p test_coverage_control.py -v
      - name: Check full-trajectory replay matching and failure accounting
        run: |
          python scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 120 --minimum-tests 5 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records/trajectory-tests.json" \
            -- python -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/memory_cell_mem1 \
            -p test_trajectory_coverage.py -v
      - name: Check prospective selector plans, failures and independent scoring
        run: |
          python scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 120 --minimum-tests 15 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records/selector-study-tests.json" \
            -- python -B -m unittest -v ndu_real_runtime.test_candidate_selection_plan \
            ndu_real_runtime.test_run_candidate_selection ndu_real_runtime.test_candidate_selection_report
      - name: Check frozen cohort and failed-attempt accounting
        run: |
          python scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 180 --minimum-tests 7 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records/candidate-runner-tests.json" \
            -- python -B -m unittest -v ndu_real_runtime.test_run_candidate_retention
      - name: Check composition paths and partial native failure costs
        run: |
          python scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 120 --minimum-tests 7 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records/composition-tests.json" \
            -- python -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/memory_cell_mem3 \
            -p test_mechanism.py -v
      - name: Check fixed-public retention attribution and fresh-session memory
        run: |
          python scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 240 --minimum-tests 35 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records/mem6-tests.json" \
            -- python -B -m unittest -v ndu_real_runtime.test_candidate_retention_public_plan \
            ndu_real_runtime.test_candidate_retention_public \
            ndu_real_runtime.test_candidate_retention_public_actor \
            ndu_real_runtime.test_candidate_retention_inference \
            ndu_real_runtime.test_episodic_memory ndu_real_runtime.test_episodic_retrieval \
            ndu_real_runtime.test_episodic_qualification
      - name: Retain final source state
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records"
          git rev-parse HEAD > "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records/source-after.txt"
          git status --porcelain > "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records/source-status-after.txt"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SOURCE_SHA"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
      - name: Retain test and dependency evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: mem-python-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/mem-records
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
postimage:
name: Hepta MEM candidate and replay controls

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/hepta-mem-python.yml
      - scripts/ndu_real_runtime/**
      - scripts/ndu_real_materials/**
      - scripts/memory_cell_mem1/**
      - scripts/memory_cell_mem3/**
      - experiments/multimodal_output_portfolio/joint_hepta_20261029/hepta_core.py
      - scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py
      - codex-rs/hepta-memory/**
      - codex-rs/hepta-agentd/**
      - codex-rs/hepta-agent-protocol/**
      - codex-rs/rust-toolchain.toml
      - .github/actions/setup-ci/**
      - scripts/format.py
      - scripts/run-nextest.py
      - justfile
  push:
    branches:
      - research/mem-integrated-20261109-a6b21bc7
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: hepta-mem-python-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
  TESTED_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
  BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}
  HEPTA_CI_LANE: source-head
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
  PYTHONPATH: scripts:.
  OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
  MKL_NUM_THREADS: "1"
  OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS: "1"

jobs:
  episodic-integrity:
    name: Source-memory receipts and post-update revocation
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 8
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact source commit
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.SOURCE_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Bind source-head identity before integrity tests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem7-records"
          git rev-parse HEAD HEAD^{tree} > "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem7-records/source-before.txt"
          git status --porcelain > "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem7-records/worktree-before.txt"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SOURCE_SHA"
          test ! -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem7-records/worktree-before.txt"
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a309ff8b426b58ec0e2a45f0f869d46889d02405
        with:
          python-version: "3.12.16"
      - name: Check standard-library integrity and fresh readers
        run: |
          python scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 180 --minimum-tests 24 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem7-records/tests.json" \
            -- python -B -m unittest -v ndu_real_runtime.test_episodic_memory \
            ndu_real_runtime.test_episodic_retrieval \
            ndu_real_runtime.test_episodic_qualification \
            ndu_real_runtime.test_revocation_qualification
      - name: Record the isolated revocation campaign
        run: |
          python -B -m ndu_real_runtime.run_revocation_qualification \
            --source-commit "$SOURCE_SHA" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem7-records/campaign"
      - name: Bind source-head identity after integrity tests
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem7-records"
          git rev-parse HEAD HEAD^{tree} > "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem7-records/source-after.txt"
          git status --porcelain > "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem7-records/worktree-after.txt"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SOURCE_SHA"
          test ! -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem7-records/worktree-after.txt"
      - name: Retain integrity evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: mem7-integrity-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/mem7-records
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
  native-owner:
    name: Staged native episodic owner contracts
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 120
    env:
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "2"
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
      CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG: "0"
      CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: "0"
      SOURCE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref || github.ref }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.SOURCE_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 2
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Bind exact comparison and staged source presence
        id: stage
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          records="$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records"
          mkdir -p "$records"
          exec > >(tee "$records/preflight.log") 2>&1
          if [[ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" == workflow_dispatch ]]; then
            BASE_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD^)"
            echo "BASE_SHA=$BASE_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          fi
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_history.py --commit "$BASE_SHA" --commit "$SOURCE_SHA"
          git rev-parse HEAD HEAD^{tree} > "$records/source-before.txt"
          git status --porcelain > "$records/worktree-before.txt"
          printf '%s\n' "$SOURCE_REF" "$SOURCE_SHA" "$BASE_SHA" > "$records/event-identity.txt"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SOURCE_SHA"
          test ! -s "$records/worktree-before.txt"
          git diff --binary "$BASE_SHA" "$SOURCE_SHA" > "$records/source.patch"
          git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMRT -z "$BASE_SHA" "$SOURCE_SHA" > "$records/source-paths.zlist"
          tar --null -T "$records/source-paths.zlist" -czf "$records/changed-source-before.tar.gz"
          memory=false; control=false; protocol=false; drain=false
          [[ ! -f codex-rs/hepta-memory/src/episodic_source.rs ]] || memory=true
          [[ ! -f codex-rs/hepta-agentd/src/production_episodic_control_tests.rs ]] || control=true
          [[ ! -f codex-rs/hepta-agent-protocol/src/episodic.rs ]] || protocol=true
          [[ ! -f codex-rs/hepta-agentd/src/production_episodic_drain_tests.rs ]] || drain=true
          printf 'memory=%s\ncontrol=%s\nprotocol=%s\ndrain=%s\n' "$memory" "$control" "$protocol" "$drain" | tee "$records/stages.txt" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          printf 'Absent stages have no native test result; infrastructure success is not owner qualification.\n' >> "$records/stages.txt"
          cat "$records/stages.txt" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          [[ "$control" == false || ( "$memory" == true && "$protocol" == true ) ]]
          [[ "$drain" == false || "$control" == true ]]
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-ci
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@d86e0fa8f147d6539442c26a61ebba8becc19489
        with:
          toolchain: "1.96.0"
          components: rustfmt, clippy
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@08807647e7069bb48b6ef5acd8ec9567f424441b
        with:
          version: "0.11.3"
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@44c6d64aa62cd779e873306675c7a58e86d6d532
        with:
          tool: nextest@0.9.103
      - name: Retain native tool versions
        shell: bash
        working-directory: codex-rs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          { rustup show active-toolchain; rustc --version --verbose; cargo --version; just --version; cargo nextest --version; uv --version; } 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records/tools.log"
      - name: Format exact PR changes and reject any source rewrite
        run: |
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 900 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records/format.json" \
            -- just fmt --base "$BASE_SHA"
      - name: Install existing native build prerequisites
        if: steps.stage.outputs.memory == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          { sudo apt-get update; sudo apt-get install -y build-essential clang cmake protobuf-compiler libssl-dev libcap-dev pkg-config bubblewrap; } 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records/native-prerequisites.log"
      - name: Resolve repository-verified V8 inputs for the control stage
        if: steps.stage.outputs.control == 'true'
        run: |
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 900 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records/v8-inputs.json" \
            -- python3 scripts/hepta_ci_v8.py
      - name: Test staged memory owner contracts on unchanged source
        if: steps.stage.outputs.memory == 'true'
        run: |
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 6600 --minimum-tests 1 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records/memory-tests.json" \
            -- just test --locked -p codex-hepta-memory --lib episodic
      - name: Build and bind the exact Codex executable for real App Server drain
        if: steps.stage.outputs.drain == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 6600 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records/codex-build.json" \
            -- cargo build --locked --manifest-path codex-rs/Cargo.toml -p codex-cli --bin codex
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          import stat
          import subprocess

          metadata = json.loads(subprocess.check_output([
              "cargo", "metadata", "--locked", "--no-deps", "--format-version", "1",
              "--manifest-path", "codex-rs/Cargo.toml",
          ]))
          binary = Path(metadata["target_directory"]) / "debug" / "codex"
          before = binary.lstat()
          if not stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) or not os.access(binary, os.X_OK):
              raise SystemExit("exact-source Codex binary is not an executable regular file")
          digest = hashlib.sha256()
          with binary.open("rb") as handle:
              for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
                  digest.update(chunk)
          after = binary.lstat()
          if (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) != (
              after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns
          ):
              raise SystemExit("Codex binary changed while recording its identity")
          record = {
              "source_sha": os.environ["SOURCE_SHA"],
              "source_tree": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}"], text=True).strip(),
              "path": str(binary),
              "bytes": after.st_size,
              "sha256": digest.hexdigest(),
          }
          records = Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"]) / "mem-native-records"
          (records / "codex-binary.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
          with Path(os.environ["GITHUB_ENV"]).open("a") as handle:
              handle.write(f"CARGO_BIN_EXE_codex={binary}\n")
          PY
      - name: Test staged Agentd control contracts on unchanged source
        if: steps.stage.outputs.control == 'true'
        run: |
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 6600 --minimum-tests 1 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records/agentd-tests.json" \
            -- just test --locked -p codex-hepta-agentd --lib episodic --no-capture --retries 0
      - name: Test the qualification feature preserves explicit memory isolation
        if: steps.stage.outputs.control == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          records="$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records"
          # Nextest 0.9.103 resolves store.dir under the Rust workspace;
          # its report directory is independent of CARGO_TARGET_DIR.
          junit="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/codex-rs/target/nextest/local/junit.xml"
          test -f "$junit"
          test ! -L "$junit"
          test ! -e "$records/agentd-nextest.junit.xml"
          mv "$junit" "$records/agentd-nextest.junit.xml"
          profile_exit=0
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 1200 --minimum-tests 1 \
            --output "$records/agentd-qualification-profile-tests.json" \
            -- just test --locked -p codex-hepta-agentd --features qualification-cognitive-write \
            --lib app_runtime::tests::episodic_embedding_keeps_the_store_but_removes_implicit_memory_paths \
            --no-capture --retries 0 || profile_exit=$?
          if [[ -f "$junit" && ! -L "$junit" ]]; then
            cp "$junit" "$records/agentd-qualification-profile.junit.xml"
          fi
          if [[ "$profile_exit" -ne 0 ]]; then
            exit "$profile_exit"
          fi
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from datetime import datetime
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          import uuid
          import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

          records = Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"]) / "mem-native-records"
          previous = ET.parse(records / "agentd-nextest.junit.xml").getroot()
          current = ET.parse(records / "agentd-qualification-profile.junit.xml").getroot()
          receipt = json.loads((records / "agentd-qualification-profile-tests.json").read_text())
          cases = current.findall(".//testcase")
          expected = "app_runtime::tests::episodic_embedding_keeps_the_store_but_removes_implicit_memory_paths"
          if (len(cases) != 1 or cases[0].get("name") != expected
                  or current.get("tests") != "1" or current.get("failures") != "0"
                  or current.get("errors") != "0"
                  or any(cases[0].find(tag) is not None for tag in ("failure", "error", "skipped"))
                  or receipt["status"] != "passed" or receipt["observed_passed_tests"] != 1
                  or receipt["observed_failed_tests"] != 0):
              raise SystemExit("qualification profile did not pass exactly its original case")
          run_uuid = str(uuid.UUID(current.attrib["uuid"]))
          if run_uuid == previous.get("uuid"):
              raise SystemExit("qualification profile reused a previous nextest report")
          case_time = datetime.fromisoformat(cases[0].attrib["timestamp"])
          if not (datetime.fromisoformat(receipt["started_at"]) <= case_time
                  <= datetime.fromisoformat(receipt["finished_at"])):
              raise SystemExit("qualification profile case is outside its execution interval")
          PY
      - name: Test protocol package after the control stage is present
        if: steps.stage.outputs.control == 'true'
        run: |
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 1800 --minimum-tests 1 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records/protocol-tests.json" \
            -- just test --locked -p codex-hepta-agent-protocol
      - name: Run scoped fixes after tests and reject any source rewrite
        if: steps.stage.outputs.memory == 'true'
        env:
          CONTROL_PRESENT: ${{ steps.stage.outputs.control }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          packages=(codex-hepta-memory)
          if [[ "$CONTROL_PRESENT" == true ]]; then
            packages+=(codex-hepta-agentd codex-hepta-agent-protocol)
          fi
          for package in "${packages[@]}"; do
            python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 6600 \
              --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records/fix-$package.json" \
              -- just fix --locked -p "$package"
          done
      - name: Retain final source, full rewrite patch and changed files
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          records="$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-native-records"
          mkdir -p "$records"
          exec > >(tee "$records/final-source.log") 2>&1
          git rev-parse HEAD HEAD^{tree} > "$records/source-after.txt"
          git status --porcelain > "$records/worktree-after.txt"
          git diff --binary HEAD > "$records/source-rewrites.patch"
          git diff --cached --binary > "$records/index-rewrites.patch"
          git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMRT -z HEAD > "$records/rewrite-paths.zlist"
          git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z >> "$records/rewrite-paths.zlist"
          tar --null -T "$records/rewrite-paths.zlist" -czf "$records/changed-source-after.tar.gz"
          if [[ -f "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/codex-rs/target/nextest/local/junit.xml" ]]; then
            cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/codex-rs/target/nextest/local/junit.xml" "$records/last-nextest.junit.xml"
          fi
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path

          records = Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"]) / "mem-native-records"
          identity = records / "codex-binary.json"
          if identity.exists():
              before = json.loads(identity.read_text())
              binary = Path(before["path"])
              digest = hashlib.sha256()
              with binary.open("rb") as handle:
                  for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
                      digest.update(chunk)
              after = dict(before, bytes=binary.stat().st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())
              (records / "codex-binary-after.json").write_text(json.dumps(after, indent=2) + "\n")
              if before != after or binary.is_symlink():
                  raise SystemExit("the bound Codex executable changed during native validation")
          PY
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SOURCE_SHA"
          cmp "$records/source-before.txt" "$records/source-after.txt"
          test ! -s "$records/worktree-after.txt"
      - name: Retain native logs and exact-source evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: mem-native-${{ env.SOURCE_SHA }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/mem-native-records
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
  python:
    name: Frozen candidate and coverage contracts
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact source commit
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.SOURCE_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a309ff8b426b58ec0e2a45f0f869d46889d02405
        with:
          python-version: "3.12.16"
      - name: Retain source and install real CPU actor dependencies
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          records="$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records"
          mkdir -p "$records"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SOURCE_SHA"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
          git rev-parse HEAD HEAD^{tree} > "$records/source-identity.txt"
          python --version > "$records/python-version.txt"
          python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check \
            --report "$records/torch-install.json" \
            --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu 'torch==2.9.1+cpu'
          python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check \
            --report "$records/numeric-install.json" 'numpy==1.26.4' 'Pillow==12.0.0'
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends tesseract-ocr tesseract-ocr-eng
          dpkg-query -W 'tesseract*' > "$records/ocr-packages.txt"
          python -m pip check > "$records/dependency-check.txt"
          python -m pip freeze --all > "$records/installed-versions.txt"
      - name: Check real actor and independent candidate evidence
        run: |
          python scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 300 --minimum-tests 17 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records/candidate-tests.json" \
            -- python -B -m unittest -v ndu_real_runtime.test_candidate_memory \
            ndu_real_runtime.test_candidate_runtime ndu_real_runtime.test_candidate_retention_report
      - name: Check identical-support selectors and bound action receipts
        run: |
          python scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 120 --minimum-tests 10 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records/selector-tests.json" \
            -- python -B -m unittest -v ndu_real_runtime.test_candidate_selector \
            ndu_real_runtime.test_selector_runtime
      - name: Check replay matching and incomplete-run accounting
        run: |
          python scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 120 --minimum-tests 6 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records/replay-tests.json" \
            -- python -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/memory_cell_mem1 \
            -p test_coverage_control.py -v
      - name: Check full-trajectory replay matching and failure accounting
        run: |
          python scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 120 --minimum-tests 5 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records/trajectory-tests.json" \
            -- python -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/memory_cell_mem1 \
            -p test_trajectory_coverage.py -v
      - name: Check prospective selector plans, failures and independent scoring
        run: |
          python scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 120 --minimum-tests 15 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records/selector-study-tests.json" \
            -- python -B -m unittest -v ndu_real_runtime.test_candidate_selection_plan \
            ndu_real_runtime.test_run_candidate_selection ndu_real_runtime.test_candidate_selection_report
      - name: Check frozen cohort and failed-attempt accounting
        run: |
          python scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 180 --minimum-tests 7 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records/candidate-runner-tests.json" \
            -- python -B -m unittest -v ndu_real_runtime.test_run_candidate_retention
      - name: Check composition paths and partial native failure costs
        run: |
          python scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 120 --minimum-tests 7 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records/composition-tests.json" \
            -- python -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/memory_cell_mem3 \
            -p test_mechanism.py -v
      - name: Check fixed-public retention attribution and fresh-session memory
        run: |
          python scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --timeout-seconds 240 --minimum-tests 35 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records/mem6-tests.json" \
            -- python -B -m unittest -v ndu_real_runtime.test_candidate_retention_public_plan \
            ndu_real_runtime.test_candidate_retention_public \
            ndu_real_runtime.test_candidate_retention_public_actor \
            ndu_real_runtime.test_candidate_retention_inference \
            ndu_real_runtime.test_episodic_memory ndu_real_runtime.test_episodic_retrieval \
            ndu_real_runtime.test_episodic_qualification
      - name: Retain final source state
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records"
          git rev-parse HEAD > "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records/source-after.txt"
          git status --porcelain > "$RUNNER_TEMP/mem-records/source-status-after.txt"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SOURCE_SHA"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
      - name: Retain test and dependency evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: mem-python-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/mem-records
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
